HexKagune 6.0.0 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**New in 6.0.0**
- Vanish: with Ayato's Steel Blade out, or in Kaneki's Full Kakuja, breaking into a sprint makes you vanish in a gust of wind for 5 seconds. Nobody sees anything of you (body, armour, held items, kagune, name, shadow) and mobs lose track of you. Attacking in any way (swings, abilities, shots, any damage you deal) or leaving the form brings you back. 30 second cooldown. Kaneki's centipede legs stay still while he is vanished.
- Dash: in those forms, right click dashes forward (W or no key) or backward (S). The Steel Blade dashes far, Kaneki's Full Kakuja much less.
- A spent kagune: when your RC reaches 0 the kagune goes back in and can't come out again for 10 seconds. Only the eyes stay.
- The Steel Blade in first person is held and swung exactly as other players see it, and the blade is slimmer.
- Ayato's first kakuja: the M1 volleys throw fewer needles, and the J Needle Gatling fires far faster and spins up in a second, so the barrage is worth using.
- Kaneki has his own menu, as polished as Ayato's: organ, mastery, forms, RC, the kakuja's keys, the mutation tree, an Adjust Kakugan button, and the original screen for colours, shape and toggles.
- The abilities board shows the Steel Blade (C), its swings, dash, vanish and fireballs, and the Full Kakuja's dash and vanish.
- 6.0.0 can't be mixed with older versions: the server and every player need 6.0.0.

**Since 5.0 (the betas)**
- Ayato's final kakuja: the Steel Blade (C). The steel wings close round your right arm into a massive feathered steel cone with one curved cutting edge, a needle point and a jagged row of barbs. It forms in sequence with a glint along the edge, held in a relaxed hold that never touches the ground. It cuts in three real swings (sweep, backhand, overhead execution), you move far faster and jump far higher, and blood flies along every cut and stains the blade.
- Wounds open where you were actually hit, in the shape of what hit you, and deep ones show the bone and flesh beneath; they heal with their own animation.
- Kaneki's and Ayato's kakuja burst out of the body and shatter when they end; the kakugan glows in the dark and in the kakuja; crystal thorns break Kaneki's grab; Kaneki's Auto Projectile guards with his tentacles.
- Fixed: the outer skin layer and the kakugan no longer drift or vanish during animations (3D Skin Layers and similar).
